name: NGC 4267 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4267, a lenticular galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4267-hubble
story: A lenticular galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, hiding a bar that does not show at a glance but reveals itself in the shapes of its light contours. Hubble surveyed it to learn how early-type galaxies form and evolve.

claims.text: It is a confirmed member of the Virgo Cluster
A bar not apparent by visual inspection is inferred from its isophotes
The ACS Virgo Cluster Survey (GO-9401) aims to understand how early-type galaxies form and evolve
